name: USU Aggie Ice Cream (Aggie Blue Mint / Vanilla Bean — Lactase Required)
brandOrRestaurant: USU Aggie Ice Cream (Logan / Utah State University, UT)
whyItWorks: Iconic Utah State University creamery ice cream; smooth, nut-free, seedless flavors like Vanilla Bean, Cookies & Cream, or Aggie Blue Mint (white chocolate & cookies, no nuts) have zero insoluble fiber when paired with lactase enzymes in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a single kiddie/small scoop of Vanilla Bean or Aggie Blue Mint in a cup, and take 2 lactase enzyme tablets before the first bite.
watchOuts: Extra-rich 16% butterfat dairy cream—strictly requires lactase enzymes and remission status; avoid Aggie Bull Tracks or Raspberry flavors with nuts/seeds
